subject: Tamil Nadu Finance Minister Palanivel Thiaga Rajan (DMK)
claim: The state BJP chief released two audio clips in which a voice said to be Thiaga Rajan criticized his own party's leaders. He called both clips fabricated and machine-generated.
finding: Rest of World had the clips tested by independent experts. Results on the first clip were inconclusive. The second was assessed as authentic, not a deepfake.
outcome: He kept insisting the clips were fake. No independent analysis backed that for the second clip.

sources.title: An Indian politician says scandalous audio clips are AI deepfakes. We had them tested
'Blame it on AI': How 'Deepfakes' Become an Easy Excuse to Dismiss Reality
